narrative.northStar: The official department course file — stamped, ruled, one highlighter.
narrative.overview: StudySyncPlus reads like the college's official Semester III course file: paper-white ground, iron-black ink, true 1px hairline rules, and stamped marks that carry trust. The palette is user-pinned (white / near-black / single lime accent) and lime does real jobs only — primary action, active subject mark, verified stamp, lead data series. Revision 2 moves the composition editorial: the page ground is generous whitespace, density lives inside ruled containers, and the hero, discovery, cards, and footer were each stripped to their essential job.
keyCharacteristics: True 1px hairlines on --rule; ink rules demote section boundaries
One lime accent doing real jobs; roughly ≤4 lime instances per viewport region
Archivo for display/UI, JetBrains Mono strictly for data
Tabular numerals in every count, size, and rating
Editorial page rhythm: unboxed hero, one discovery band, calm 3-column card grid, single-row footer
